content: Portrait cultural narrative illustration of ceramic craftsmanship. A principal elderly potter shapes clay with both hands against a large blue-white floral plate; smaller scenes show shaping, porcelain painting, firing and selling, accompanied by blue-white vessels, traditional buildings, flowering branches and flowing water motifs. Recompose details without adding lettering, logos or watermarks.
